name: Prismatic Spray

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: 60-foot Cone: each creature makes a Dex save against a random coloured ray (12d6 of a random damage type, creeping petrification or banishment).
text: Roll 1d8 per creature: 1-5 deal 12d6 Fire, Acid, Lightning, Poison or Cold (half on a success); 6 Restrains on a failure, then Con saves at the end of its turns until three successes free it or three failures Petrify it; 7 Blinds on a failure, then a Wis save at the start of your next turn ends it or, on a failure, sends the creature to another plane. On an 8 the creature is hit by two rays (reroll 8s).
